title: DermKG: A Concept-Centric Knowledge Graph for Interpretable Skin Disease Diagnosis from Dermatological Morphology
abstract: arXiv:2611.27283v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dermatologists describe lesions with a standardized morphological lexicon, which makes concept-based models attractive for interpretable skin disease diagnosis. How much diagnostic information these concepts actually carry, however, is rarely quantified. We present DermKG, a concept-centric knowledge graph built on the expert-annotated SkinCon subset of Fitzpatrick17k (3,230 images, 48 concepts, 113 diseases). DermKG has 3,452 nodes of 8 types and 19,365 edges of 11 relation types, and encodes disease concept profiles, concept co-occurrence, a three-level diagnostic hierarchy, and 20 clinical morphology rules, all of which are supported by the training data (15 strong, 5 moderate). An information-ceiling analysis shows that the 3,230 lesions collapse onto only 813 distinct concept vectors, bounding concept-only top-1 accuracy at 38.9\% for diseases and 77.6\% for the nine categories. translated_abstract: 皮肤科医生使用标准化的形态学术语词汇来描述皮损，这使得基于概念的模型在可解释的皮肤病诊断中极具吸引力。然而，这些概念实际承载了多少诊断信息却很少被量化。我们提出了DermKG，一个以概念为中心的知识图谱，构建于Fitzpatrick17k数据集中经专家标注的SkinCon子集之上（包含3,230张图像、48个概念、113种疾病）。DermKG包含8种类型的3,452个节点和11种关系类型的19,365条边，编码了疾病概念特征、概念共现关系、三级诊断层次结构以及20条临床形态学规则，所有这些均由训练数据支持（15条强规则、5条中等规则）。信息上限分析表明，3,230个皮损仅坍缩为813个不同的概念向量，这将仅基于概念的疾病top-1准确率限制在38.9%，九大疾病类别的top-1准确率限制在77.6%。在此上限范围内，DermKG-Net——一种图神经网络（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文构建了首个以概念为中心的皮肤病知识图谱DermKG（3,452个节点、19,365条边，涵盖疾病概念特征、共现关系、诊断层级和临床规则），首次量化了形态学概念所承载的诊断信息上限（疾病38.9%、九大类别77.6%），并据此提出图神经网络DermKG-Net以实现可解释的皮肤病诊断。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DermKG, a concept-centric knowledge graph with 3,452 nodes and 19,365 edges encoding disease-concept profiles, concept co-occurrence, a three-level diagnostic hierarchy, and clinical morphology rules, which for the first time quantifies the diagnostic information ceiling of morphological concepts (38.9% for diseases, 77.6% for nine categories) and enables interpretable skin disease diagnosis via the graph neural network DermKG-Net.
